Rule for negative or incomplete response
PAD020=1 requires PAQ050Q=1–100, PAQ050U=1/2/3 and PAD080=10–600 min. Contribution: PAQ050Q × k × PAD080 / 30, where k=30, 30/7 or 1 for day, week or month.
Negative domain: zero qualifying minutes. Positive with invalid required details: missing.
PAQ100=1 requires PAD120=1–120 and PAD160=10–600 min. Contribution: PAD120 × PAD160 / 30.
PAD320=1 requires ≥1 PAQIAF row with PADLEVEL=1; every row must have PADTIMES=1–300 and PADDURAT=10–600 min. Contribution: sum(PADTIMES × PADDURAT) / 30.
Same domain rule; multiple activity rows per person are expected
PAD200=1 requires ≥1 PAQIAF row with PADLEVEL=2; every row must have PADTIMES=1–300 and PADDURAT=10–600 min. Contribution: 2 × sum(PADTIMES × PADDURAT) / 30.

Gate / days / minutes: vigorous work PAQ605/PAQ610/PAD615; moderate work PAQ620/PAQ625/PAD630; transport PAQ635/PAQ640/PAD645; vigorous recreation PAQ650/PAQ655/PAD660; moderate recreation PAQ665/PAQ670/PAD675. Gate=1 requires days=1–7 and minutes=10–1440. Each contribution is days × minutes × intensity weight / 7; weight=2 for vigorous domains and 1 otherwise.
Negative domain: zero qualifying minutes. Positive with invalid required details: missing.
